review_locator: PMCID:PMC4066200, Biased and G Protein-Independent Signaling of Chemokine Receptors
primary_title: The chemokine receptor CCR1 is constitutively active, which leads to G protein-independent, β-arrestin-mediated internalization
decision_basis: CCR1 expression produces a bounded Gi-family coupling branch with cAMP inhibition and migration, distinct from β-arrestin-dependent internalization.
limitations_preserved: Preserve constitutive versus ligand-evoked activity and Gi/β-arrestin branch separation; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC8206557, Roles of Cholecystokinin in the Nutritional Continuum
primary_title: Pancreatic acinar cell signalling and function exhibit an absolute requirement for activation of Gαq
decision_basis: CCK1R engages Gq/11 directly in BRET assays and Gq/11 inhibition suppresses native CCK-induced acinar calcium and secretory responses.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CCK1R ligand/cell context and Gq/11 preference; no exclusivity, SCI or terminal-TF inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC3523293, Gastrin-releasing peptide receptors in the central nervous system
primary_title: Structures of human gastrin-releasing peptide receptors bound to antagonist and agonist for cancer and itch therapy
decision_basis: Active-state agonist-bound human GRPR-Gq structures directly support the proximal receptor coupling layer.
limitations_preserved: Preserve GRPR/BB2, peptide agonist and Gq/11 structural context; no universal coupling, SCI or terminal-TF inference.
